categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Modifies test framework utilities in `test/functional/test_framework/crypto/secp256k1.py` and `test/functional/test_framework/key.py` with the 'Tests' label.
categories.rationale: Substantially cuts functional test runtime by optimizing fixed-base multiplication and caching x-only public keys in the test framework. The author reports that median runtime for `feature_taproot.py` decreased from 83.39s to 35.42s on an M2 Pro Mac, yielding real test speed benefits that are nonetheless reasonably deferrable.
